column3: brief K19: `--quiet` and `--json` do not silence the runner: its banner, every step, the summary and report paths still print on stderr
column5: With `--quiet` (with or without `--json`) and with `--json` alone, stderr carries no runner banner, Setup/Execution headers, per-step lines, summary table or report paths for `run`, `diff capture` and `ci run`. • A failing run under `--quiet` still prints the failing step and its message (one or a few lines) and grantiva's `Error:` line; under `--json` the document's `error` names the failed step and message (e.g. `02-exact-negative: assertVisible text="Golden Gate.*" exact=true: Element not visible ...`) and never says "see the runner output above". • Plain mode (no flags) is unchanged; `--verbose` still shows the runner output. • stdout stays byte-identical across plain/`--quiet`/`--verbose` (already true). • GrantivaCoreTests (RunnerExecutionTests): with a quiet request, a fake runner's stdout is not written to stderr; with a normal request it is. GrantivaCLITests (OutputStreamContractTests): `--json` failure `error` contains the step message. (brief K19 Acceptance criteria; Platforms: both)

column5: `--continue-on-failure` repro: output names `Broken` and its failed step (e.g. `✗ Broken: tap "No Such Element" — Element not found ...`), `Home` shows as captured, then 01-browse runs; exit 1. • The summary reports screens and flows separately, e.g. `Screens: 2 total, 1 captured, 1 failed` and `Flows: 1 total, 1 passed`; flow screenshots are not counted as screens. • No `/var/folders/.../grantiva-flows-*/flow.yaml` path and no flow named `flow` in the runner's relayed output; the screens session is called `screens` (or each screen by name) in live output, ready file and report. • The ready file lists the screens session (`screens`, `failed`) alongside `01-browse` when both ran. • Timeout repro: `Error: grantiva killed the screens session after 30s (--timeout <seconds> to raise the cap). It was at screen "Slow".` (wording free; no dangling colon, no "interrupt"). • GrantivaCoreTests (FlowGeneratorTests): the generated screens flow carries a `name:` and per-screen labels; GrantivaCLITests (RunCommandTests): the summary counts for 2 screens (1 failed) + 1 flow; a RunnerSession test for the timed-out screens message. Screenshot paths, if kept, move to a field on that entry (e.g. `screenshots: [{name, path}]`) or a separate top-level array, documented. • Configured screens (screens session) keep one entry per screen, in both outcomes. • The key set is documented in README next to :383-386, with an example of each. • GrantivaCLITests (OutputStreamContractTests): decode a passing and a failing document for the same flow file and assert identical key sets and entry kinds; GrantivaCoreTests: the success collector builds per-flow steps from a fixture report.json. column3: brief L01: Android inputText fails on the fixed 10 s HTTP timeout of the key-actions request even though the text was typed
column4: 3 x `run --no-build --flow .maestro/03-edit.yaml --report-dir r$i` alone on `cov2-android` (`emulator ensure` defaults, software rendering; record `hw.gpu.*` from its config.ini), then the stock set; the `inputText " Renamed"` step duration
column5: On a software-rendered API 35 AVD (`emulator ensure` defaults, `hw.gpu.mode` resolving to lavapipe), 03-edit passes 3 of 3 runs alone and inside the stock set (12/12 with 10-seed-many per L03), and `inputText " Renamed"` finishes within the step timeout. • A request that is still in progress when a fixed transport deadline would have expired is governed by the step's deadline instead (context from the step, or a per-request timeout at least the remaining step time); no UIAutomator2 call is cut at a hard-coded 10 s while its step still has time. • If the key-actions request does time out, the runner reads the focused field; when it holds the expected `before + text`, the step passes (optionally with a note that the server answered late); otherwise it fails naming UIAutomator2 and the timeout, without repeating the cause. • Typing does not grow linearly into the timeout: either chunk long text into several `/actions` requests or size the deadline from the character count; an 8-character append on the slow AVD takes well under the step timeout. • Runner tests: pkg/uiautomator2 — a fake server that answers `/actions` after 12 s with a 30 s step context succeeds, and one that never answers fails at the step deadline, not at 10 s. pkg/driver/uiautomator2 (next to input_append_test.go) — `SendKeyActions` returns a timeout error but the fake field then reads "Golden Gate Bridge Renamed": `inputText` succeeds; the field still reads "Golden Gate Bridge": it fails. column3: brief L02: On Android a find request blocked against a crashing app stalls the crash check for 10 s, and assertVisible then passes on the dead app

(brief L03 Acceptance criteria, docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-12-coverage-issues-round2/ on coverage-campaign e27f0a4; Platforms: android)
